pkgmetadata.longdescription:
NEC's FT (fault-test) monitor for the SX-Aurora TSUBASA MMM stack: the ftmon engine plus the boot-error detection catalog (/var/opt/nec/ve/td/ft/catalog) and the FTs/*.nec test script tree. ve_monitor executes ftmon after Init 2 to decide whether the card booted cleanly; without it the daemon logs "FT File Open Failed" and latches the card UNAVAILABLE.
Split out of the vendor's mmm RPM family exactly as upstream ships it (ftmon is a separate RPM from mmm).
